review_candidates.description: RAF Lossiemouth, Moray, Scotland, IV31 6SD Job Summary We currently have an opportunity for an individual to join The Test and Measurement Equipment Cell (TMEC) within the Technical Support Squadron (TSS) at RAF Lossiemouth. We are looking to recruit a suitably skilled and motivated individual to support the effective management and control of test and measuring equipment. The role is critical to maintaining equipment availability, calibration compliance and operational capability in support of frontline engineering activities. This position requires a proactive and organised individual with good attention to detail, effective communication skills and the ability to work independently while contributing positively to the wider team. Experience of test equipment, calibration, engineering or logistics would be advantageous, but a willingness to learn and develop is essential. This position is advertised at 37 hours per week. Job Description The Test and Measuring Equipment Controller is responsible for the effective management, control and availability of Test and Measuring Equipment (TME) within the organisation. Responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to): Maintaining a database of TME for RAF Lossiemouth and other Units that fall under the RAF Lossiemouth Parenting Agreement. Monitor equipment holdings and identify shortages, surpluses, obsolescence and emerging capability risks. Ensure unserviceable, suspect or damaged equipment is appropriately identified, segregated and controlled to prevent inadvertent use. Contribute to investigations into damaged, lost, incorrectly used or otherwise compromised test equipment. Raise and support the management of safety occurrences, equipment discrepancies and non-conformities where appropriate. Compiling and distributing monthly Calibration Call Forwards Notifications and Routine Maintenance (RM) Notifications for items of test equipment. Updating records with condition, calibration dates, RM dates, modifications and any other detail changes. Inspection of equipment upon receipt to carry out calibration date checks and comprising item checks. Support the introduction, codification and onboarding of new items of test equipment into the equipment management and calibration process. Supporting the Squadrons Unit Movements Officers by overseeing and coordinating test equipment required for out of area purposes. Maintaining a close liaison with the TMEC Logistician for the receipt, despatch and progression of logistical transactions pertaining to items of test equipment. Working together with external agencies and industry partners to arrange onsite / offsite calibrations and repairs. Identify opportunities to improve existing processes, documentation and methods of working to enhance efficiency, assurance and service delivery. NOTE: The role of the TME Controller is not exclusively administrative in nature. While the position includes a significant administrative element, it also requires the individual to undertake practical activities, including the inspection and checking of test and measuring equipment, identification of equipment condition and serviceability, and associated manual handling activities. These duties are integral to the effective management and control of test equipment and should therefore be recognised as part of the role’s overall responsibilities.
